title: Queue launch scope remediation fixes
summary: Hardens queue launch single-file scope validation, adds explicit CSV rerun dry-run preview evidence, broadens Force Stop operator evidence to match related process-tree termination, and adds focused launch/control/WebView regression coverage.
reason: The queue launch scope review found risks that could let an operator misunderstand which file or process scope would run, rerun CSV work live without a preview path, or see Force Stop wording that understated the backend termination scope.
behavior_before: Single-file launch did not consistently enforce and expose source-root/file/suffix validation evidence across backend start and backend preflight, CSV rerun WebView controls did not provide an explicit preview-only request path, Force Stop copy/result data did not clearly state the related pipeline/audit/rerun process-tree scope, and selected-vs-filtered queue launch behavior plus active-job fallback behavior lacked focused regression coverage.
behavior_after: Backend single-file launch validates normalized paths against configured source roots, existing files, file kind, and supported media suffixes before start and exposes the validation in success/preflight payloads; CSV rerun has separate preview-only and live start requests with preflight text; Force Stop confirmation, tooltips, history, and result data name the related pipeline/audit/rerun process-tree scope; launch/control/WebView tests pin selected-vs-filtered launch scope and active-job fallback behavior.
